target_description: Reach Minecraft-class product quality through a sequence of verified releases: authored expedition, building expression, world variety, interaction feel, living ecology, long-term progression, finished co-op, durable performance, cohesive presentation, and onboarding/audio/accessibility.

overall_score.foundation: strong: streamed voxel world, survival, crafting, save/load, boats, fishing, controller/co-op plumbing
overall_score.current_release_slice: v1.27.0 Tidewatch Expedition connects the first voyage, discovery, reward, persistent journal, co-op cue, authored prop, ecology accent, and original audio feedback
overall_score.remaining_gap: not Minecraft parity; building depth, regional world breadth, full co-op productization, long-session performance profiling, and wider accessibility remain active release tracks

checklist.detail: Tidewatch Wreck provides a visible discovery → reward → return journey.
Signal-torch reward connects expeditions to harbor building; deeper materials/furniture remain.
Authored offshore wreck joins existing BVI cove/forest/rootwalk routes; caves and more regional destinations remain.
Persistent log, first-voyage cue, notifications, and a dedicated discovery stinger provide clearer feedback.
The wreck includes low-cost animated seabirds, complementing existing reef and shore life.
Discovery Log persists named discoveries and expedition rewards.
Fresh co-op routes and shared journal language now frame a shared first voyage.
Visual prop is bounded and disposal-owned; long-session browser measurement remains required.
Signal lantern, wreck, sail, gull silhouettes, and HUD route cue improve offshore readability.
Original discovery stinger and actionable early route copy complement existing responsive/accessible menu work.
